value.body: A UPSC exam held once a year that recruits Group A geoscientists for the Geological Survey of India (Geologist, Geophysicist, Chemist) and the Central Ground Water Board (Scientist 'B' in hydrogeology, geophysics and chemistry), and related posts. It has a preliminary exam, a main exam and a personality test.

items.label: Qualification
items.value: A master's in Geology, Applied Geology or a related geoscience
items.note: Exact subjects differ by post; chemist posts need an M.Sc in Chemistry

items.label: Age limit
items.note: Relaxations for reserved categories; check the current notice

items.label: Vacancies in the latest notice
items.note: Geological Survey of India and Central Ground Water Board posts; the final number can change

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Complete a master's in Geology, Applied Geology, Geophysics or another subject listed for the post (final-year students can usually apply). Apply when UPSC notifies the exam, clear the preliminary and main papers in your stream, and then the interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: A B.Sc alone is not enough; the exam needs a relevant master's.
Posts come with fieldwork across India, including remote areas.
Vacancies vary from year to year; check each UPSC notice.
M.Sc Environmental Science is generally not listed among eligible subjects.
